description: This file defines the ModelDescriptionGenerator class responsible for generating model descriptions for various data types, including complex types, enums, collections, and simple types, within a web API help page context.

classes.name: ModelDescriptionGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates model descriptions for different data types used in API documentation, supporting complex types, enums, collections, and simple types.

methods.name: GetOrCreateModelDescription
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a model description for a given type, handling various data structures and types.

methods.name: GenerateComplexTypeModelDescription
methods.description: Generates a model description for a complex object type, including its properties and fields.

methods.name: GenerateEnumTypeModelDescription
methods.description: Generates a model description for an enum type, including its values.

methods.name: GenerateCollectionModelDescription
methods.description: Generates a model description for collection types, including element descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateDictionaryModelDescription
methods.description: Generates a model description for dictionary types with key and value descriptions.

methods.name: GenerateSimpleTypeModelDescription
methods.description: Generates a model description for simple, primitive types.

methods.name: GetMemberName
methods.description: Determines the display name of a member, considering JSON and DataMember attributes.

methods.name: ShouldDisplayMember
methods.description: Decides whether a member should be included based on ignore attributes and data contract status.

methods.name: CreateDefaultDocumentation
methods.description: Provides default documentation string for a type, using custom or default mappings.

methods.name: GenerateAnnotations
methods.description: Creates annotations for a property based on its attributes, such as validation attributes.
